title: F1 - data/functions/<function_id>.json
description: The 541 mechanical function records. FOUNDATION 2.4 gives deltas only; the base field set is the existing organ.

efh.propertyOrderEvidence: All 541 files at data/functions/*.json emit exactly two key orders (537 files without text_integrity, 4 with it), and the 24-key order below is a prefix-consistent superset of both. FOUNDATION 2.4 line 168 says 'The existing 26 fields stay' but does not list them and does not state where the new fields insert; the observed order is the only traceable statement of the contract, so it is what is recorded here. The 26-vs-observed-21-base discrepancy is recorded in tools/schemas/README.md and not resolved by invention.
efh.keyOrderContract: Emit keys in propertyOrder exactly. axis_provenance, classification, axes and vintage are data-keyed objects emitted in ordinal key order per FOUNDATION 2.3 line 160.

pendingRequired.schema: FOUNDATION 2.3 line 161 says 'Every file carries schema'. No F1 file at HEAD carries one and no delta in 2.4 adds one, so it is not in required. Recorded, not invented.

short_source.efhObservationNote: Measured 2026-07-31 over all 541 files at data/functions/*.json: short_source is 'microsoft-english-verbatim' on 502 files and 'no-short-description' on 39 files; 'differs-from-english-description' occurs on 0 files. FOUNDATION 2.4 line 177 names only two values and 502 is the figure it states for the first. The third value is a real divergence between the spec table and the generated organ. It is reported by efh-validate check and is NOT added to the enum here, because adding it would silently amend the spec.

text_integrity.description: O (new, DELTA D-7, FOUNDATION 2.4 line 178). These three mechanical fields ONLY. A3-S6: suspected_lost and verified move to F12 as a lossy-text gap, because an inference may not sit in mechanical data/.

oxfunc_tree_clean.description: R (new, DELTA D-8, FOUNDATION 2.4 line 179). false blocks publication of this file. A3-S12.

vintage.description: R (new, DELTA D-8, FOUNDATION 2.4 line 179). Maps each field group to the OxFunc state it came from. FOUNDATION names ten groups and required lists exactly those ten; the generated organ emits nineteen keys (a superset), which is permitted by additionalProperties and recorded in tools/schemas/README.md. Feeds absence string A-09's replacement, the permanent basis clause (FOUNDATION 4.2 lines 849-854).
